items.source: Builder method used to configure and customize the internal Jackson ObjectMapper created by this GenericJackson2JsonRedisSerializer and used to de/serialize objects as JSON.
items.translation: 用于配置和自定义由本类创建的内部 Jackson ObjectMapper 的构建器方法，该 ObjectMapper 用于将 对象 序列化和反序列化为 JSON。

items.source: Creates a new instance of GenericJackson2JsonRedisSerializer with configuration options applied.
items.translation: 使用配置选项创建一个新的GenericJackson2JsonRedisSerializer实例。

items.source: Serialization/Deserialization package for converting Object to (and from) binary data.
items.translation: 用于将对象转换为（以及从）二进制数据进行序列化和反序列化的包。
